articleTitle: Lightning protection for wireless telecommunication transceiver facilities (WiTF)
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE Symposium on Product Compliance Engineering (SPCEB-Boston)
abstract: A great deal of wireless telecommunication transceiver facility (WiTF) equipment is installed outdoors, on towers, tall buildings, and the like, where exposure to lightning is a concern. A determination of how this equipment is protected from a lightning exposure must be assessed. Does the structure provide protection? Do the power and communication lines require surge protection devices? This paper explores lightning protection schemes for wireless telecommunication transceiver facilities (WiTF).

abstract: Welcome to PSES's first Regional SPCE. With the primary ISPCE now set in San Jose (CA) every May, and since some may not be able to travel to it, the PSES Board of Governors decided to try national and international regional SPCE events. Boston is the first in the US, and Taiwan is the first internationally and will be held in December in Taipei.
